scripts.db:init: docker compose up -d postgres && node scripts/init-db.mjs
scripts.dev: docker compose up -d postgres && node scripts/init-db.mjs && next dev
scripts.build: docker compose up -d postgres && node scripts/init-db.mjs && next build
scripts.start: docker compose up -d postgres && node scripts/init-db.mjs && next start
scripts.test: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:integration
scripts.db:check: node -e "const { Client } = require('pg'); const client = new Client({ connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL }); client.connect().then(() => { console.log('Database connection OK'); return client.end(); }).catch((error) => { console.error(error.message); process.exit(1); });"
